classifiers.original: StandardScaler + LogisticRegression C=1 lbfgs max_iter=2000; exactly reproduce original held-out donor predictions/recall.
classifiers.balanced: Same fixed C, solver and scaling, with class_weight=balanced. Diagnostic sensitivity only; never replaces the original gate.
classifiers.neighbors: Exact Euclidean 30-neighbor uniform vote over training donors, no scaling of latent axes, stable distance/source-index ties and lexicographic label ties.

design.strata: Retain every donor, treatment and source cell type; no subset or threshold selected using diagnostic outputs.
design.localGeometry: Use every cell and the original retained global exact 30-neighbor lists. Summarize source-type composition in NK neighborhoods, by donor and condition.
design.acceptance: No new acceptance gate. Reproduce the original classifier metrics exactly; retain original failed gates even if a different diagnostic improves.
design.qualification: Exploratory failure localization on an already inspected cohort; not independent biological validation or an integration method change.
